description: This file defines a login route component for a Remix-based web application. It includes server loaders and actions for authentication, as well as a React component for rendering the login form and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Checks if the user is already logged in; if so, redirects to home page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes login form submission to authenticate user and create session.

methods.name: default
methods.description: React component rendering the login form UI.
